mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty_transactions (customer_id, type, points, balance, ref_type, ref_id, note) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{type}, #{points}, #{balance}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM loyalty_transactions WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM loyalty_transactions WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
